payload.pseudocode:
def filter_data_by_oper_sequence_range(dataframe, start_process_name, end_process_name):
    # 1. 시작 공정명과 끝 공정명에 해당하는 OPER_SEQ 값 조회
    start_oper_seq_row = dataframe[dataframe['OPER_NAME'] == start_process_name].iloc[0]
    end_oper_seq_row = dataframe[dataframe['OPER_NAME'] == end_process_name].iloc[0]

    # 2. OPER_SEQ 값을 숫자로 변환
    start_seq_numeric = int(start_oper_seq_row['OPER_SEQ'])
    end_seq_numeric = int(end_oper_seq_row['OPER_SEQ'])

    # 3. 데이터프레임을 OPER_SEQ 숫자 범위로 필터링
    filtered_df = dataframe[
        (dataframe['OPER_SEQ'].astype(int) >= start_seq_numeric) &
        (dataframe['OPER_SEQ'].astype(int) <= end_seq_numeric)
    ]
    return filtered_df
